svg.title: ESP Sensor Station wiring diagram
svg.desc: XIAO ESP32-C5 connected to an SCD4x breakout, LD2410C radar and eight normally open switches. D4 GPIO23 is SDA; D5 GPIO24 is SCL; radar TX connects to D7 GPIO12. Each button connects its own GPIO to a shared switch return. One 1 kilohm resistor connects that shared return to board ground. Sensor grounds connect directly to board ground. XIAO pads follow the manufacturer top view with USB at the top: left D0 to D6; right 5V, GND, 3V3, D10, D9, D8, D7. Sensor blocks show electrical labels only.
